integrity: Analytical proof accompanies executable exact polynomial-identity checks and deterministic numerical diagnostics; no independent scientific verification or publication-priority certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Applies only to the published exact four-direction slit diffusivity with 0<a<=2, eta>1, tau_r>0, nonnegative squared wall speed; it does not establish the same thresholds for continuous-angle swimmers or porous geometries. The boundary tau=infinity is a supremum, not a finite admissible optimizer. The published formula and qualitative two-scenario observation are credited.
title: Exact coexistence and tricritical scaling of optimal transport in a mobile-wall run-and-tumble slit
